AR-RNG04B.title: Centsys Nova TX4 434MHz 4-Button Transmitter
AR-RNG04B.features:
• Genuine or high-quality compatible replacement
  • Secure code-hopping / rolling code technology
  • Controls up to 4 devices
  • Compact, durable design
  • Battery included
  • Easy programming
  • Australian stock
  • 12-month warranty
AR-RNG04B.compatibility:
Compatible with the following Centsys / Centurion receivers:

  • ✅ Nova Helix
  • ✅ SupaHelix
  • ✅ Nova
  • ✅ Suitable replacement for Duratronic TM4

Not compatible with: all-green or all-red button models.
AR-RNG04B.instructions:
📖 Programming Instructions

  1. Press and hold the desired button on the new remote.
  2. Press the Learn or Link button on the Centsys receiver until the indicator confirms.
  3. Release the remote button and test operation.

⚠️ Important Information

  • Please check your Centsys opener model before ordering.
  • The appearance of your existing remote does not always determine compatibility.
  • Incorrect model or frequency selection may result in the remote not working.
  • If you're unsure which remote you need, contact our team before purchasing.

AR-RCM48.title: Merlin M842RS 434MHz 2-Button Remote
AR-RCM48.features:
• Genuine or high-quality compatible replacement
  • Merlin Legacy RF technology
  • Controls up to 2 garage doors or gates
  • Compact keyring design with green buttons
  • Battery included
  • Easy programming
  • Australian stock
  • 12-month warranty
AR-RCM48.compatibility:
Compatible with Merlin openers sold between 2001 and 2007 (must have Learn button):

  • ✅ Merlin M430R Prolift
  • ✅ Merlin M230T
  • ✅ Merlin M-500 Receiver
  • ✅ Merlin M-501 Receiver
  • ✅ Merlin M-502 Receiver

Note: Not compatible with openers using DIP switches (not Learn button).
AR-RCM48.instructions:
📖 Programming Instructions

  1. Press and hold the desired button on your new remote.
  2. Press and release the Learn button on the Merlin opener panel.
  3. Wait for the opener light to flash or for confirmation.
  4. Test the remote operation.

⚠️ Important Information

  • Please check your Merlin opener model before ordering.
  • The appearance of your existing remote does not always determine compatibility.
